skill.name: docx
skill.description: Create, edit, inspect, and validate Microsoft Word DOCX files with OOXML-aware workflows for text, comments, tracked changes, images, and formatting.
skill.summary: Work with DOCX files through OOXML editing, document generation, comments, and tracked changes.
skill.author: DYAI2025

security_audit.summary: The audit confirmed unsafe archive extraction in the Office unpack and validation helpers, plus instructions that ask agents to install dependencies with sudo or globally with npm. Most static findings are false positives from OOXML namespace URLs, schema imports, XML template lines, Markdown examples, and document ID bookkeeping.

remediation.suggestion: Replace ZipFile.extractall with safe extraction that rejects absolute paths, parent-directory traversal, symlinks, and entries resolving outside the destination directory.

remediation.issue: Privileged and global dependency installation instructions
remediation.suggestion: Remove sudo apt-get and npm install -g commands from automated workflows. Document dependencies for manual installation or use an isolated environment.

remediation.issue: External document-processing tools run on user files
remediation.suggestion: Keep subprocess calls shell-free, run them in a sandbox when possible, set timeouts, and document that untrusted documents should be processed in isolation.

content.value_statement: DOCX files are hard to edit reliably because they combine zipped XML, relationships, and formatting rules. This skill provides workflows and helper scripts for creating, inspecting, modifying, and validating Word documents.
actual_capabilities: Create new DOCX files with the JavaScript docx library guidance.
Unpack DOCX, PPTX, or XLSX files into editable OOXML folders.
Edit Word XML with helper classes for comments, replies, and tracked changes.
Validate DOCX structure, relationships, content types, and tracked-change behavior.
Add images and update related OOXML relationship and content type entries.
Convert documents to markdown, PDF, or page images when supporting tools are available.
limitations: Some workflows require local tools such as pandoc, LibreOffice, Poppler, Python packages, or npm packages.
The unpack scripts must be hardened before use on untrusted Office archives.
Complex formatting changes still require manual OOXML inspection and careful validation.
The skill does not provide a graphical Word editor or real-time collaboration features.

use_cases.title: Draft structured Word documents
use_cases.description: Generate polished DOCX files with headings, tables, images, page breaks, and consistent styles.

use_cases.title: Review contracts with tracked changes
use_cases.description: Apply precise insertions, deletions, and comments while preserving review history and document structure.

use_cases.title: Repair or inspect OOXML packages
use_cases.description: Unpack a document, inspect XML relationships, fix content, and validate the rebuilt file.

prompt_templates.title: Create a simple DOCX
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a DOCX document with a title, three sections, a small table, and a short conclusion.

prompt_templates.title: Extract and summarize content
prompt_templates.prompt: Read this DOCX file, preserve the heading structure, and summarize the main points and open questions.

prompt_templates.title: Add comments and tracked changes
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this DOCX contract and add tracked changes plus comments for unclear obligations and inconsistent terms.

prompt_templates.title: Repair OOXML relationships
prompt_templates.prompt: Unpack this DOCX, inspect broken relationships or content types, repair the OOXML package, and validate the rebuilt file.

output_examples.input: A user asks for a formatted project proposal as a Word document.
output_examples.output: A DOCX file with a title page, section headings, formatted paragraphs, a timeline table, and image placeholders.

output_examples.input: A user provides a contract and asks for review edits.
output_examples.output: A revised DOCX with tracked insertions, tracked deletions, reviewer comments, and a validation summary.

output_examples.input: A user reports that a Word file opens with a corruption warning.
output_examples.output: An OOXML inspection summary that identifies missing relationships, missing content types, and recommended repairs.

best_practices: Work on a copy of the document and keep the original file unchanged until validation succeeds.
Validate after each batch of tracked changes instead of waiting until the final document.
Use precise XML node selection and preserve unchanged runs when adding redlines.
anti_patterns: Do not unpack untrusted Office files with unsafe archive extraction code.
Do not replace whole paragraphs when only a few words need tracked changes.
Do not install system or global dependencies automatically from a skill workflow.

faq.question: Can this skill create new Word documents?
faq.answer: Yes. It provides guidance for creating DOCX files with the JavaScript docx library.

faq.question: Can it edit existing DOCX files?
faq.answer: Yes. It can unpack a DOCX file, edit OOXML files, and rebuild the document.

faq.question: Does it support tracked changes?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes workflows and helper methods for precise insertions, deletions, and validation.

faq.question: Does it support comments?
faq.answer: Yes. The helper library can add comments, replies, comment relationships, and comment metadata.

faq.question: Are extra tools required?
faq.answer: Some workflows need tools such as pandoc, LibreOffice, Poppler, defusedxml, lxml, or the docx npm package.

faq.question: Is it safe for untrusted DOCX files?
faq.answer: Not without hardening. The archive extraction helpers need path validation before handling untrusted files.
